title: Automated Client Inquiry Triage for Logistics
business: Logistics coordinators managing high-volume freight inquiries.
problem: Coordinators spend excessive time manually reading and categorizing incoming emails, leading to delayed responses for urgent shipping quotes.
solution: Using the Gmail plugin connector, the system automatically scans incoming emails, extracts key logistics data points, and drafts categorized responses within the ChatGPT interface for human review.
steps: Authenticate the Gmail plugin connector within the ChatGPT environment.
Define a prompt to search for specific keywords like 'quote' or 'urgent' in the inbox.
Instruct the model to parse the email body for origin, destination, and cargo weight.
Generate a draft response based on the extracted data for coordinator approval.
Execute the send command via the connector after final verification.
outcome: Improved response latency and reduced manual data entry errors for logistics coordinators.
limitation: The connector operates on a per-request basis and may not handle high-frequency real-time streaming of thousands of emails simultaneously, which can be verified by checking for API rate limit errors during high-volume periods.
